answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm the payoff directly with them at your appointment and send it the same day. Yes, two things come out of what you receive: the $99 home pickup fee, and the loan payoff, since you get whatever is left after Pinewood is paid. Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff. If they end up receiving an extra payment, they refund it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan closes.
